usage: music-tagger rip [-h] [--device DEVICE] [--release-id RELEASE_ID]
                        [--unknown] [--replace]
                        [path]

Rip a CD to FLAC via whipper with AccurateRip verification.

positional arguments:
  path                  Output directory for FLAC files (default: a new temp
                        staging directory).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --device DEVICE       CD drive device (default: /dev/cdrom).
  --release-id RELEASE_ID
                        MusicBrainz release ID to match.
  --unknown             Continue ripping if the CD is not in MusicBrainz.
  --replace             Overwrite files from an earlier rip of this disc in
                        the output directory.
